title: Scoped security endorsement and decision log for SAML/RBAC/KMS onboarding
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Purpose: capture clarified requirements, enumerate scope changes from the original PRD, and provide an endorsement checklist and decision log for SSO (SAML), RBAC, audit logging, and KMS/HSM integration for Private deployment customers. This ticket converts prior open questions into a binding acceptance matrix and a phased endorsement plan the Security and Platform teams can sign against. It focuses on operator actions, customer evidence, and minimal-viable-manuals for first wave customers.
scope_changes: 1) Removed automatic cross-tenant key delegation from MVP; will be delivered in Phase 2. 2) Added explicit operator HSM quorum test and documented emergency key-escrow flow. 3) Scoped RBAC to role templates (Admin, Operator, Auditor, App) instead of freeform RBAC in MVP. 4) Regional audit-log replication optional for first release; required for GA in regionally regulated customers.
requirements_summary: SSO/SAML: support IdP-initiated and SP-initiated flows, SAML 2.0 assertions with NameID, and attribute mapping for role assignment; metadata refresh endpoint and certificate rotation without infra downtime.

RBAC: enforce role templates; scoped resource permissions by model, deployment, and project; role assignment via claim mapping and via console UI; ephemeral operator elevation with approval audit recorded.
Audit logs: immutable append-only audit stream, per-tenant retention config, admin access path, tamper-evidence headers, and available export to customer SIEM (syslog/CloudWatch/ELK).

KMS/HSM: support customer-managed keys (CMEK) with HSM-backed signing for at-rest secrets; rotation workflow that preserves active inference sessions; offline rotation test harness for operator verification; dual-control for key escrow access.
Operational: onboarding checklist for customers, operator runbooks for emergency revoke, automated verification scripts for telemetry and traceability, and documented SLO for auth latency under load.
acceptance_criteria: SAML integration: integration test matrix green across three IdP vendors (Okta, Azure AD, OneLogin) with both IdP-initiated and SP-initiated flows recorded in CI.
RBAC enforcement: runtime policy engine enforces role templates; unit and e2e tests show unauthorized requests are denied and audited with correct resource tags.
Audit integrity: evidence of append-only storage (hash chain) and sample export of 30 days of tenant logs to a customer SIEM validated by the security team.
KMS/HSM: CMEK set up end-to-end with customer key provisioning, successful HSM-backed decrypt/encrypt flows, and a documented rotation that does not break active inference requests.

Operator evidence: operator acceptance checklist completed and signed by Infra Lead and Security Lead; at least two independent engineers reproduce onboarding steps from the runbook without direct author support.
decision_log: 2026-03-03: (PM) Lock MVP RBAC to role templates; freeform RBAC postponed — agreed with Security and Product.
2026-03-04: (Security) Require HSM dual-control for key escrow — accepted. Operator approval flow to be documented.
2026-03-06: (Eng) Regional audit replication for GA only; MVP will provide single-region durable export and opt-in replication.
2026-03-09: (PM) Add explicit e2e test targets for three IdP vendors; CI gating required for merge to release branch.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: Key rotation could interrupt long-running inference sessions. Mitigation: implement session key pinning for active requests and provide a transparent fallback to software-wrapped keys during rotation window.
Risk: SAML metadata expiry leads to unexpected lockouts. Mitigation: automated metadata refresh plus a health endpoint that alerts 14 days before cert expiry.
Risk: Audit export ingestion failures at customer SIEM. Mitigation: retries/backoff with dead-letter and operator dashboard showing export delivery status.
test_plan: Integration: run SAML e2e harness (Okta/AAD/OneLogin) in CI with simulated failover and certificate rotation scenarios.
KMS: HSM-backed encrypt/decrypt tests plus rotation simulation under load with telemetry collection for latency impact.
RBAC: automated policy fuzz tests and negative authorization cases across templates; include impersonation and elevation attempts.
Audit: verify hash-chain immutability in staging and validate export to a dummy SIEM endpoint with schema validation.
